title: Follow nouns through a new text
instructions: Read the whole text, then choose the set of words for all three gaps.

parts.prompt: Ben bought ___ used bicycle from a neighbour. ___ bicycle needed new brakes, and there were ___ shops nearby that could repair it.

choice_rationales.A: Used begins with a ‘y’ sound, so it takes a, and little goes with uncountable nouns.
choice_rationales.B: The first mention needs a, and much goes with uncountable nouns.
choice_rationales.C: Used begins with a consonant sound, the reader then knows the bicycle, and shops can be counted.
choice_rationales.D: A is right first, but the second mention needs The.

parts.hint: Listen to the first sound of ‘used’.
parts.correct_explanation: Used takes a by sound, the second mention takes The, and countable shops take few.
